{{redirect|Eileen|the English voice actress|Eileen Stevens}} {{CharInfobox| color={{psychic color}} | corecolor={{psychic color light}} | bordercolor={{psychic color dark}} | name=Queen Ilene | jname=アイリーン | tmname=Eileen | slogan=no | image=Ilene.png | size=150px| caption=Queen Ilene | gender=Female | colors=yes | eyes=Green | hair=Blonde | hometown=[[Rota]] | region=[[Kanto]] | relatives=[[Queen Rin]] (ancestor)| trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M08| epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew| enva=[[Erica Schroeder|Bella Hudson]]| java=Momoko Kikuchi| }} '''Queen Ilene''' (Japanese: '''アイリーン''' ''Eileen'') is a supporting character who appeared in ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. She is the current queen of [[Rota]] and resides in [[Cameran Palace]]. ==In the movies== Queen Ilene officially opened [[Rota]]'s annual {{pkmn|battle}} tournament and watched the matches from the royal viewing box with her maid {{OBP|Jenny|M08}} and her {{p|Mime Jr.}} Later, Ilene remained on her throne as the other guests enjoyed the subsequent banquet and ballroom dancing. Following {{OBP|Lucario|M08}}'s unexpected arrival, Queen Ilene confronted him in his former sleeping quarters. Lucario initially mistook her for [[Queen Rin]], but Ilene clarified that she was her ancestor and that a lot had changed since Lucario's era. In another throne room, Queen Ilene explained the legend of [[Sir Aaron]] to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Queen Ilene instructed Lucario to help guide Ash and the others to the [[Tree of Beginning]], where {{AP|Pikachu}} had been taken to by {{OBP|Mew|M08}}. She watched from [[Cameran Palace]] as Ash and the others departed. She later witnessed the Tree of Beginning descend into chaos, and later thanked Ash and his friends when they returned to the palace after resolving the crisis. Ilene briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine {{pkmn|movie}}s. ===Character=== Ilene closely resembles her ancestor, [[Queen Rin]]. Like Rin, she is kindhearted and respected by her citizens. Queen Ilene has a deep attachment to her kingdom and refused to evacuate [[Rota]] even when the [[Tree of Beginning]] began to collapse and threatened the integrity of [[Cameran Palace]]. She continues the old traditions of her kingdom, hosting festivities to honor the past, and the castle maintains its luxury heritage aesthetics. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Queen Ilene |pkmn=Mime Jr. |type1=Psychic |img=Queen Ilene Mime Jr.png |epnum=M08 |width=73 |epname=Lucario and the Mystery of Mew |vajp=Miyako Itō |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Mime Jr.}} is the queen's Pokémon who started the tournament along with Queen Ilene. It had a playful personality and enjoys mimicking those around it. It was always seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside of its Poké Ball]]. It briefly reappeared in a montage in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', which chronicled the preceding nine movies.
